entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I bought a helmet, and I'm just so confused by everything on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Oh, sure. It's VF-8675309. I just... I got it a while ago, and the color is all wrong. It's for my son, and he says it clashes with his bike. The box is still unopened.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up that order for the Aero Road Helmet. One moment. [typing sounds] Okay, I see the order was delivered 44 days ago, on November 27th.
Is that bad? I saw some things online about 10 days or 20 days, and I got overwhelmed. I don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?

Of course, let's take a look. I'm just checking our official return policy right now. [typing sounds] Okay, simple enough. According to my knowledge base, for a standard item like this helmet, we have a 90-day return window.
Ninety days? So... so it's okay to return it?
Yes, absolutely. You are well within the timeframe. I'm glad you're focused on getting the right gear for proper safety. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you.
Oh, thank goodness. What do I do now?

I've just sent a return shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unopened box, we'll process your full refund.
Wow, okay. Thank you so much, Sarah. You made that much less stressful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
